gbm_population_evidence.quote: HSRT and IMRT Chemoradiotherapy for Newly Diagnosed GBM

candidate_evidence.quote: This study aims to evaluate the safety and effectiveness of the combination of 30Gy/5fx HSRT and 20Gy/10fx IMRT adjuvant therapy.
Temozolomide: Temozolomide 75 mg/m2 concurrently administered with RT.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: HSRT and IMRT Chemoradiotherapy for Newly Diagnosed GBM

role_evidence.quote: Temozolomide once daily (75mg/m2/d) orally administered concurrently with radiotherapy.

coder_notes: Single-arm radiotherapy fractionation trial (HSRT + IMRT). Temozolomide given at standard concurrent dose as backbone; the investigational question is the radiotherapy schedule, not the drug. Conditions field says 'Glioma, Malignant' but title and inclusion name GBM / glioblastoma multiforme.
